Game Overview

At its heart, Skebob Gun is a action game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Skebob Gun keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Skebob Gun?

Skebob Gun is a free action game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Skebob Gun free to play?

Yes, Skebob Gun is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
